# Eventbrite UK

> > Eventbrite UK is a global event discovery and ticketing platform helping people find and attend local events across major cities in the United States and internationally.

Eventbrite connects event organizers with attendees, offering tools for event creation, promotion, and ticket sales. The platform covers a wide range of events including concerts, festivals, conferences, workshops, and community gatherings across major metropolitan areas.

## Key Topics

- Event discovery
- Local events
- Event ticketing
- City-based event browsing
- New York events
- Los Angeles events
- Chicago events
- Washington DC events
- San Francisco events
- US cities event directory
- Event organizers
- Community events
- Event promotion
- Things to do

## Event Discovery

- [Discover Local Events & Things to Do](http://wastewaterinfra.eventbrite.co.uk/): Main event discovery homepage featuring local events across major US cities including New York, Los Angeles, Chicago, and more
